title: The Recursive Filing Vault

features.name: the unspooling cart
features.desc-on-touch: a file cart that processes its own contents, documents shuffling endlessly between trays, each one filing itself before being refiled again

features.name: the recursive stamp
features.desc-on-touch: a rubber stamp that marks each document with the filing reference of the document that filed it, creating a chain of self-processing

features.name: the desk of infinite forms
features.desc-on-touch: a filing desk where forms multiply by comparison—each new entry finds resemblances in older files, spawning cross-references that breed new forms

features.name: the window to the processing chamber
features.desc-on-touch: through this panel, you see an office-within-the-office, another filing vault processing this filing vault's own processing records

inscription: each document files the one that files it; arrival never ends because processing never ceases

file.name: Form_Registry_Cross_Reference_Loop_1987-2024.txt
file.note: a filing manifest where entries reference their own position numbers, creating loops of self-justifying documentation

exits.label: back toward the intake chamber where arrival became official
upward into levels of filing where documents file the documents that file them
toward the Comparisons, where resemblance between forms begins to matter more than content
